paragraphs.notes: This page is the patent family annex to the International Search Report drawn up by the ISA for PCT/EP99/06627. It is the search report, not part of the disclosure: it carries none of the applicant's description, claims or examples. doc_part is set to description only because the schema offers no search-report value. The subtitle is printed 'Information on patent family members' but the scan clips its left edge, so it is transcribed verbatim as it appears. Printed English form furniture, no German prose, so zh and en are the same string.
